purpose: Canonical registry for production TalkSys capabilities. Check this file before creating a new subsystem or version-suffixed source file.

runtime.entry.responsibility: Production HTTP/API entry point and top-level request orchestration
runtime.entry.migrationNote: Legacy versioned filename. Keep as canonical until a deliberate no-behavior-change rename is performed.

grounding.policy.responsibility: Grounding/search requirement policy and contextual factual-risk detection
grounding.policy.migrationNote: Reuse or extend this policy rather than introducing another grounding classifier.

search.execution.responsibility: Search planning, provider execution, recovery queries, evidence collection and search budgets
search.execution.migrationNote: v46 search work should extend this capability, not create search-v46.js.

evidence.validation.responsibility: Query-to-result relevance/evidence gate used to reject unrelated retrieval results
evidence.validation.migrationNote: General evidence/claim validation should evolve from this gate instead of adding a parallel verifier.

structured.tools.responsibility: Structured/free API intent detection and execution
structured.tools.migrationNote: Add supported structured sources here or through its existing companion modules before inventing a new router.

conversation.memory.responsibility: Conversation memory handling and continuity support
conversation.memory.migrationNote: Do not create a second conversation-memory subsystem without an explicit replacement decision.

search.rerank.migrationNote: Ranking changes should extend this capability unless the registry is deliberately updated.

speech.stt.responsibility: Current speech-to-text path used by the v45 web application
speech.stt.migrationNote: Legacy versioned filename; future replacement requires registry update.

ui.web.migrationNote: Legacy versioned filename; future replacement requires registry update.
